CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_positive(
    quantity integer
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
AS $$ SELECT quantity > 0 AND NULL::example_input IS NULL
$$;

CREATE DOMAIN positive_int AS integer
  CONSTRAINT positive_int_check CHECK (is_positive(VALUE));
ALTER TYPE example_input ADD ATTRIBUTE quantity positive_int;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_quantity(
    p example_input
)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE sql
VOLATILE
RETURN (p).quantity;
ALTER TYPE example_input ADD ATTRIBUTE region region_row;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION has_region(
    p example_input
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
VOLATILE
RETURN ((p).region IS NOT NULL);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION region_present()
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
VOLATILE
AS $$ SELECT has_region(NULL::example_input)
$$;
